description: Engine §4.2, §6 and §7.10: different omission records retain two root classes despite equal erased token values.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elision-only
%rule text e [+T]
%conditions $.without-elision.parse(w)
%rule e a [+U] | b [+V]
%erased
%rule a A
%rule b A
%rule w A [+U] [+T] | A [+V] [+T]
